## Validation

- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `go test -race ./...`
- [ ] `go vet ./...`
- [ ] `bash -n install.sh` (when installer changes)

## Review checklist

- [ ] Comments and user-facing messages are in English.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, local configuration, or generated binaries are included.
- [ ] Compatibility and migration impact is documented.
